Interesting Git repos of the week:

Detection:

* https://github.com/reversinglabs/reversinglabs-yara-rules - Reversing Labs YARA
* https://github.com/interplains/zero-breach - hunt the AdFection / Candiru ad-delivered spyware campaign

Exploitation:

* https://github.com/google/kernel-research - GOOG's tools for kernel research
* https://github.com/vu-ls/tapioca - deep dive your packets with @wdormann

Hard hacks:

* https://github.com/Th0rgal/open_oura - messing with the Oura ring via BTLE 🤖
* https://github.com/SAMS0N1TE/lr2021-sdr - making your LoRa chip listen harder
* https://github.com/qkaiser/broadcom-wps - tools from @qkaiser to check for Broadcam's wireless howler 🤖
* https://github.com/vu-ls/firmware-vulfinder - quickly validate firmware for obvious bugs

Hardening:

* https://github.com/francescotinti/php-rust - a sloppy port of PHP to Rust 🤖
* https://github.com/werewolf-linux/werewolf - a fresh take on hardening with @thomrstrom@triangletoot.party

Cryptography:

* https://github.com/Fluepke/emudrahahahahaha - visit @fluepke@chaos.social's key emporium
* https://github.com/ab/emudhra-fourgery - or make your own keys, as you need them with @abrody@a.brody.zone

#security, #research, #code
